The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a piece of equipment which, unlike most other tools, does not degrade with use. It's one of three fishing rods found in-game, any of which is required for [[fishing]]. It is provided by the [[Lighthouse Keeper]], sold as a Tier III item for {{Money|500}}. It cannot be acquired through any other means, such as crafting, nor can it be studied.

Compared to the other fishing rods, this fishing rod is known as the "late-game rod", with the best efficiency, and while it can ''not'' catch all of the low-tier fish, it ''can'' catch ''all'' of the high-tier fish - unlike the 'Good' rod. In short, it's the best rod for catching the most valuable fish, yet it may fall short in regards to mid-and-low-tier varieties.

==See Also==
*{{Item|Simple fishing rod}} - the Tier I rod, serving as the quintessential "starter" rod.
*{{Item|Good fishing rod}} - the Tier II rod, serving as an upgraded 'Simple' in most cases.
